Full mod menu for **Minecraft PE v1.26.52** on iOS 17 Dopamine rootless.

Floating MC bubble (drag anywhere) with Player, Movement, Combat, World and ESP sections. v1.0.2: draggable menu window, modern blurred UI, search, collapsible sections. v1.0.3: Health Scanner — real GodMode for local worlds. v1.0.4: Value Lab — unknown-value search (air, hunger, XP, coordinates) with freeze + write; freeze XYZ to hover-fly, write XYZ to teleport.

Also works out of the box: Night Vision, Zoom, FPS counter, Coords overlay, ESP overlay. Code-patch cheats (KillAura, Speed, Fly-flag) activate via MCPEOffsets.plist once offsets are mapped.
